dedupe_keys.name: household hazardous waste characterization and recycling behavior

description: Pires, Caseiro and Guarda deposit a household hazardous-waste survey from the DaWeZard citizen-science project in the Leiria municipality of Portugal. Zenodo lists one public Excel workbook under CC BY 4.0. The provider reports 158 inquiries collected by participating scouts in October and November 2025, covering quantities in eight hazardous-waste types, disposal destinations, containers and recycling behaviour. These observations can inform household waste-generation or collection-participation assumptions in a local waste-service simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Leiria survey. A limitation is that the landing page says the questionnaire and characterisation protocol are in other Zenodo files but does not identify them here. The recruitment route and scout participation do not establish a representative household sample, and the page omits units and missing-data rates. The workbook was not downloaded, so column definitions, privacy treatment and numeric distributions were not checked. Do not generalise its results to Portugal without a sampling assessment.
